facts: Shiki reports to Genma and medical team that neck senbon technique disrupted neural conduction, needles did not penetrate spinal cord and he expects survival and recovery on withdrawal. This is Shiki's medical assessment, not established clinical certainty. Senior medic acknowledges possible compression, says imaging/assessment before withdrawal and that independent head injury caused loss of consciousness; cervical stabilization and transfer arranged. Dosu continues spontaneous respiration and is unconscious as carried away. Genma confirms Shiki won according to rules and releases him pending semifinal. Next scheduled quarterfinal match Neji Hyuga vs Shino Aburame; both rise and prepare, fight not yet begun. Lee and Guy discuss dangers and uncertainty of precise medical injury. Shiki has not declared a further action.
